tools.name: generate_social_post
tools.description: Write a social media post for a given platform and topic. The post is written to that platform's conventions, rewritten to read as human-authored, optionally scored against AI detection, and optionally illustrated with a generated image. Returns a job id immediately — poll it with check_social_job,

tools.name: check_social_job
tools.description: Look up a social post generation job by id. Returns the finished posts once the job completes, or its current progress while it runs. Costs nothing.

tools.name: list_social_platforms
tools.description: List the platforms generate_social_post supports, with each one's default post length and emoji policy. Costs nothing and makes no network call.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: generate_social_post, check_social_job, list_social_platforms · Public sink: generate_social_post, check_social_job, list_social_platforms.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: generate_social_post, check_social_job, list_social_platforms · Public sink: generate_social_post, check_social_job, list_social_platforms

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
